summary: Russian forces struck 177 energy facilities in occupied Ukrainian territories since July 1, while Ukrainian drones hit the Saratov Rosneft refinery and a Wildberries logistics hub in Russia. Russian tactical aviation operates on eastern and southeastern fronts with ballistic missile threats from Kursk region. Ground advances continue near Rodynske, Kostiantynivka, and Sukhe in Donetsk region.
key_points: Ukrainian drones attacked the Rosneft oil refinery in Saratov, hitting the key ELOU-AVT-6 primary distillation unit and causing fires at multiple industrial points (Source: @eRadarrua/103734).
Ukrainian drones struck a 178,600 m² Wildberries dual-use logistics complex in Novosemyonkino, Volga region (Source: @eRadarrua/103731).
Russian forces hit 13 more energy facilities in occupied Ukraine over 72 hours, totaling 177 energy targets since July 1 per SBS commander Robert Brovdi (Source: @UkraineNow/83116).

Russian strikes destroyed a Nova Poshta terminal in Kharkiv region and hit Rozetka warehouses in Brovary twice in 24 hours, killing one worker and injuring six (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32116, @UkraineNow/83111).

Enemy tactical aviation active on eastern and southeastern fronts; ballistic missile threats from north-eastern direction including Iskander-M/S-300 from Kursk region (Source: @kpszsu/71248, @kpszsu/71225, @mon1tor_ua/69632).
Russian forces occupied Sukhe and advanced near Nikanorivka, Rodynske, Kostiantynivka, and Zaliznychne in Donetsk region per DeepState map updates (Source: @DeepStateUA/23714, @DeepStateUA/23715).
Explosion in a central Moscow restaurant killed three and injured at least 20, possibly targeting a general's birthday celebration (Source: @UkraineNow/83097, @UkraineNow/83114).
Zelensky urged partners to supply Patriot and anti-ballistic missiles, stating they exist globally but remain in warehouses while Russia kills civilians daily (Source: @UkraineNow/83096).

sections.executive_summary: Russian forces have struck 177 energy facilities in occupied Ukrainian territories since July 1, while Ukrainian drones hit the Saratov Rosneft refinery and a major Wildberries logistics hub in Russia. Russian tactical aviation operates on eastern and southeastern fronts with ballistic missile threats emanating from Kursk region. Ground advances continue near Rodynske, Kostiantynivka, and Sukhe in Donetsk region.

points: Ukrainian drones attacked the Rosneft oil refinery in Saratov, hitting the key ELOU-AVT-6 primary distillation unit and causing fires at multiple industrial points, per eRadarrua (Source: @eRadarrua/103734).
Ukrainian drones struck a 178,600 m² Wildberries dual-use logistics complex in Novosemyonkino, Volga region, marking another strike on Russian logistics infrastructure (Source: @eRadarrua/103731).

Ukrainian air defenses maintain >90% interception rate for strike drones; IRIS-T, HAWK, NASAMS and Patriot systems operate with European partner support, per Air Forces Day statement (Source: @kpszsu/71239).
Presidential adviser Serhiy Beskrestnov claimed Russians are repairing captured Ukrainian UAVs for future provocations in Europe (Source: @UkraineNow/83110).
Zelensky emphasized that anti-ballistic missiles for Patriots exist globally but sit in warehouses, urging US and Europe to release them to protect civilians (Source: @UkraineNow/83096).
Russian forces struck 13 more energy facilities in occupied Ukraine over 72 hours, totaling 177 energy targets since July 1, per SBS commander Robert Brovdi (Source: @UkraineNow/83116).

Russian strikes destroyed a Nova Poshta terminal in Kharkiv region with trucks and containers burning, and hit Rozetka warehouses in Brovary twice in 24 hours, killing one worker and injuring six (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32116, @UkraineNow/83111).

Enemy tactical aviation active on eastern and southeastern fronts; ballistic missile threats from north-eastern direction including Iskander-M/S-300 from Kursk region (Source: @kpszsu/71248, @kpszsu/71225, @mon1tor_ua/69632).
Russian MoD confirmed continued strikes on Ukrainian transport infrastructure used for AFU supply (Source: @tass_agency/388356).

Explosion in a central Moscow restaurant killed three and injured at least 20, possibly targeting a general's birthday celebration at Balzi Rossi restaurant (Source: @UkraineNow/83097, @UkraineNow/83114).
Belarus completes formation of 37th airborne assault brigade in Gomel region bordering Ukraine, strengthening southern border section per SSO commander Ilyukevich (Source: @tass_agency/388342).
Russian forces occupied Sukhe and advanced near Nikanorivka and Rodynske in Donetsk region per DeepState map updates (Source: @DeepStateUA/23714, @DeepStateUA/23715).
Enemy advanced near Kostiantynivka and in Zaliznychne; worst situation remains near Rodynske, Kostiantynivka, along DKU and towards Sloviansk and Kramatorsk (Source: @DeepStateUA/23716).
Russian tactical aviation active on eastern front with threat of aviation weapons for frontline areas (Source: @kpszsu/71248).

Ukrainian forces reduced occupied territory by 52 sq km in July (25 in May, 27 in June) but net enemy gain in July could be 88 sq km due to delayed reporting of Ukrainian successes (Source: @DeepStateUA/23716).
Reactive UAVs detected in Chernihiv region towards Ponornytsia, Bakhmach, Ichnia, Korop, and at reservoir and Kulikivka (Source: @kpszsu/71222, @kpszsu/71220, @eRadarrua/103729).
Sumy region: one UAV and two groups of reactive UAVs; one strike UAV group reported (Source: @eRadarrua/103739, @eRadarrua/103759).
Ballistic missile threat from north-eastern direction including Iskander-M/S-300 from Kursk region (Source: @kpszsu/71246, @mon1tor_ua/69632, @eRadarrua/103764).
Kyiv region: pair of reactive guided UAVs past Bobrovytsia towards capital/Brovary; air raid alert in Kyiv at 16:24 on 02.08.2026 (Source: @eRadarrua/103749, @eRadarrua/103751).

Kherson region: reactive UAVs towards Arkhangelske/Velyka Oleksandrivka, past Kherson northern course, and in northwest/west towards Novyi Buh and Snihurivka (Source: @kpszsu/71228, @kpszsu/71212, @kpszsu/71244).
Mykolaiv region: group of reactive UAVs from south; one group of reactive UAVs reported (Source: @kpszsu/71191, @eRadarrua/103757).

Dnipropetrovsk region: over 40 Russian attacks on two districts with drones, artillery, and aviation bombs, killing two and wounding three, damaging enterprises, shops, apartment building, vehicles (Source: @UkraineNow/83127).
Russian forces struck port and vessels used for AFU supply per TASS citing Likhachev (Source: @tass_agency/388368).
Ukrainian air defenses claim >90% interception rate for strike drones; IRIS-T, HAWK, NASAMS and Patriot systems operational with European support (Source: @kpszsu/71239).
Enemy tactical aviation active on eastern and southeastern fronts; threat of aviation weapons for frontline areas (Source: @kpszsu/71248, @kpszsu/71225).

Multiple UAV types observed: reactive UAVs, guided UAVs, strike UAV groups, Shaheds (reactive) across Chernihiv, Sumy, Kyiv, Kherson, Mykolaiv, Kharkiv regions (Source: @kpszsu/71228, @kpszsu/71222, @kpszsu/71191, @eRadarrua/103739, @eRadarrua/103749, @eRadarrua/103757, @mon1tor_ua/69627).
Ballistic missile threats from north-eastern direction including Iskander-M/S-300 from Kursk region (Source: @kpszsu/71246, @mon1tor_ua/69632, @eRadarrua/103764).
Reconnaissance UAV spotted near Dergachi, Kharkiv region, potentially spotting for enemy strike assets (Source: @kpszsu/71242).

sections.threat_assessment: Russian energy infrastructure targeting in occupied territories continues at scale with 177 strikes since July 1, degrading Ukrainian civilian resilience. Simultaneous Ukrainian strikes on Russian refineries and logistics hubs demonstrate growing long-range strike capacity. Russian tactical aviation and ballistic missile threats from Kursk region maintain pressure on northern and eastern fronts. Ground advances near Rodynske and Kostiantynivka persist despite Ukrainian counter-gains. The Moscow restaurant explosion suggests potential internal instability or targeted killings. Belarusian special operations brigade formation near Ukraine adds a northern vector threat.
sections.regional_response: Zelensky's public appeal for Patriot missiles highlights critical air defense shortages against ballistic threats. European partners continue supplying IRIS-T, HAWK, NASAMS but missile stocks remain constrained. US political hesitation on Patriot and Tomahawk transfers per Trump's remarks may delay critical capabilities. Belarusian military buildup in Gomel region warrants monitoring for potential northern front activation. Russian domestic attacks on Wildberries and energy sites may provoke retaliatory strikes on Ukrainian commercial infrastructure as predicted by experts.
sections.intelligence_notes: Ukrainian UAV operations show increasing sophistication with guided drones hitting specific industrial units (ELOU-AVT-6) and large logistics complexes. Russian use of repaired Ukrainian UAVs for provocations in Europe per Beskrestnov indicates asymmetric adaptation. DeepState's delayed reporting methodology (operational security) complicates real-time frontline assessment but reveals net Russian territorial gains despite Ukrainian local successes. The 90%+ drone interception rate suggests effective air defense integration but ballistic missiles remain a critical gap. North Korean involvement and Russian autumn mobilization remain key uncertainties for 2026-2027 campaign planning.
